title: Season 1
overview: Wanda Maximoff and Vision navigate classic sitcom tropes through the decades while living in the idyllic town of Westview.

episodes.title: Filmed Before a Live Studio Audience
episodes.overview: Wanda and Vision struggle to conceal their powers during a dinner party for Vision's boss.

episodes.title: Don't Touch That Dial
episodes.overview: In an effort to blend in, Wanda and Vision perform a magic act in their neighborhood talent show.

episodes.title: Now in Color
episodes.overview: Wanda's pregnancy accelerates rapidly into the 1970s while Vision begins to suspect something is deeply wrong with Westview.

episodes.title: We Interrupt This Program
episodes.overview: Captain Monica Rambeau returns after the Blip and joins S.W.O.R.D. and Darcy Lewis outside the Westview anomaly to investigate the broadcast.

episodes.title: On a Very Special Episode...
episodes.overview: Wanda and Vision clash over Westview's reality as Billy and Tommy grow rapidly, culminating in a shocking visit from a familiar face.

episodes.title: All-New Halloween Spooktacular!
episodes.overview: During a late-90s Halloween in Westview, Vision investigates the edge of town while Wanda expands the hex boundary.

episodes.title: Breaking the Fourth Wall
episodes.overview: Wanda navigates a mid-2000s mockumentary mental break while Agnes reveals her true identity as the witch Agatha Harkness.

episodes.title: Previously On
episodes.overview: Wanda embarks on a troubling journey revisiting her past for insight into her present and future.

episodes.title: The Series Finale
episodes.overview: The events of WandaVision come to a head and the destiny of the Scarlet Witch is realized.
